scope: 1444 ordered registered-fit pairs at default presentation; five coherent turns and one representative habitat each. Reverse ordered pairs cover the opposite losing fit. No every-verb, every-habitat or all-scale claim.

habitat.source: Codex explicit adult-stage observation: four fully spread, unfolded net-veined wings and six legs on master SHA256 8b09ab3ef579a7860bec17e3fdaa82040b748d9541d2429c84d8f5e7f0d1383a. Flying adult Dragonfly, not an aquatic nymph or wingless caste.
Manually declared Earth Wolf terrestrial locomotion; side-on standing land canid master, not procedural raw habitat gene.
Manually declared Earth River Otter; standing short-legged mustelid on land, semiaquatic species, no swimming surfaces inferred.
Manually declared Heron standing on two long wading legs, two visible spread wings. Ground battle pose; no hidden undersides or flying support inferred.
Manually declared Earth Ibex standing on land, sturdy cloven-hoof quadruped; no airborne or swimming source.
Manually declared Earth Pike swimming fish; source has both pectorals/pelvics, anal and rear-set dorsal. No terrestrial support inferred.
Manually declared Goose standing on two webbed feet, both wings spread above back. Ground battle locomotion; visible spread wings permit feather-surface review but do not infer hidden undersides.
Manually declared standing Gull master: both wings folded at rest, ground locomotion in this battle asset; flight is not evidenced by this master.
Manually observed terrestrial Racer, shallow separated S curves and narrow right-facing head. No hidden segment or limb inferred.
Explicit freshwater eel; continuous dorsal/caudal/anal fringe and two visible small pectoral fins, no pelvic fins or legs.
Manually observed terrestrial Salamander, four short splayed limbs, no external ears or gills.
Explicit observed four-legged Earth Rat with fur and naked tail; master 41f8ed50d1e195f7cbd2096ac228dc48df5f9da6b1a95537d67ab3427e3c4701
Manually declared Earth Reef Shark swimming fish; paired pectorals and pelvic fins, anal and second dorsal present on source. No terrestrial support inferred.
